strict_migration_rule: Call the Rust helper only with one split modifier clause. For one safe alias, preserve legacy 20/20/5 mm defaults through the existing slot builder; every omitted or zero dimension is derived and accompanied by legacy_slot_dimensions_defaulted. Material/template contexts are not pocket aliases. Unsplit base+alias prompts and mixed same-clause operations are rejected rather than silently losing the cut.

legacy_pocket_parameters.position: x/y absent in Feature.params; OCCT pocket tool defaults both in-plane coordinates to the current body bounding-box center; side defaults positive (top/+axis).
